title: Polling loop accumulates timers via time.After

labels.defect: time.After in a loop allocates a new timer each iteration that lingers until it fires: unbounded pending timers on fast stop/start cycles
labels.evidence: Reproducible: alternate stop/start every second — each Run leaves a 30s timer (and its runtime bucket) alive; long-running daemons accumulate thousands of pending timers (runtime: => heap profile shows time.sendTime entries).
